about: Every department's route as STAGES, each with at most five commands and its gate. `kit help --stage <dept>:<stage>` and `kit status` print the shortlist for the stage you are in (RAG-MCP: a model picks the right tool far more often from a shortlist than from the whole wall; `kit help --all` keeps the wall). The route cards (kit/skills/parallax-*/SKILL.md) are these stages in prose.

brief.gate: the brief answered (what it is, tier = budget, what must WORK, whose design, the parts plan); `brief` warns until it is
commands: lune run kit new asset <snake> [--from sword]

gather.gate: the dossier approved (a real object) or a sourced size; coverage >= 2 px/mm per hero feature; two reference MODELS checked for quality; every traced part looked at
commands: lune run kit refs find "<object>" / refs patent / refs dims
lune run kit library find "<object>" -> get -> inspect -> learn
lune run kit trace <image> --name <view> --part-box ...  then  kit refs crop

sheet.gate: a complex / hero / aaa piece: the MODEL SHEET drawn with no problem (every hero feature has a picture box, a size and >= 2 px/mm) and the OWNER approved it as it is now; a prop needs none
commands: lune run kit approve 3d <name> "<the owner's words>" --by owner --stage sheet

draft.gate: a generated draft only for organic PARTS (never a hero's hard surface); glb_topology + side_check pass; the GPU otherwise idle
commands: lune run kit gen parts <name> --image <picture> --parts N
lune run kit gen views <name> --view side=<rgba.png> --view front=<rgba.png>
lune run kit vision cutout / upscale / albedo <image>

blockout.gate: the BLOCKOUT drawn from a shape round (clay, no bake) and the OWNER approved its proportions; no detail, texture or bake before it; a prop needs none
commands: lune run kit approve 3d <name> "<the owner's words>" --by owner --stage blockout

shape.gate: every traced view matched (trace_match >= 0.9) or a.not_reference(why); hero hard-surface: sections vs a reference model within 1.5 mm; organic: a calibrated form_match
commands: lune run kit cad check <name> [--only Part]
lune run kit refs sections <name> --ref <library id>

surface.gate: a look per material with its source; markings engraved at measured places; a wear preset; dark_finishes clean; texel density >= 5 on high-contrast detail

mechanism.gate: hero only, after the look passed the owner: every moving part travels without collision; the take-apart order runs

judge.gate: the verifier's diff per view (same crop of reference and render) with ONE edit; <= 10 rounds then the OWNER; never a score as progress
commands: lune run kit verdict asset <name> <0-10> "<owner's words>"

ship.gate: a game version (optimize) that spawns in Studio; public assets uploaded; the example promoted only on an owner verdict >= 7

breakdown.gate: the scene's frames in order + the technique and episode text + refs_measured/<name>.beats.md with measured colours; no preset build without them
commands: lune run kit vfx vault find "<words>"

chart.gate: the beat chart + ONE test frame of the key beat approved by the owner before a whole version
commands: lune run kit verdict vfx <set> <0-10> "<words>" --tag chart

textures.gate: every shell / beam wall / ring carries a texture made for its UV axis (refs norms rule 6); the review sheet looked at
commands: lune run kit vfx <name>  (renders changed textures)

preset.gate: the validator passes (caps, cut-offs, unknown textures / points); the pro norms (non-additive share, lives, front-loaded curves, a dark twin)
commands: lune run kit new vfx <snake> [--from starblade]

play.gate: the browser player's recording + metrics gate (one peak per hit, readable at range, <= 4 hues, not blown out) — a PREVIEW, never the proof
commands: lune run kit vfx play <name> [--record --views cine,player]

booth.gate: Studio's own capture at the chart's beats (Studio focused), beside the scene frame
commands: lune run kit vfx booth <name> [--views player,side,hero,cine]

judge.gate: the verifier: scene frame vs render per beat, one difference + ONE edit; the OWNER's verdict; never a colour / norm score as progress

ship.gate: saved by part in library/vfx (kit verify fails otherwise); a new preset name for every version; promoted only on an owner verdict >= 7
commands: lune run kit vfx vault check

refs.gate: >= 2 real stills of the exact screen type at >= 1080p, measured at 1:1 into REFS.md (never a gallery sheet, never a pasted contact sheet)

identity.gate: tokens sampled from the stills by script, a font trio, shape language, motion, bans, minimums, lettering defaults
commands: lune run kit ui identity <id> --from refs

pieces.gate: every hero piece rendered / traced / inked / lettered / spun — never a font glyph with a tint; the render reads its picture back
commands: lune run kit ui trace <id>/<piece> --from <still> --box x,y,w,h
lune run kit ui ink <id>/<piece> --from <picture> [--mode cel]
lune run kit ui letter <id>/<piece> --text ... [--style persona]

assemble.gate: pieces placed from anchors; crest_width sets the scale; children follow a warped parent; the spec compiles with its gates
commands: lune run kit new screen <Pascal> --from Arcade5Title

look.gate: the sheet LOOKED at (phone / tablet / desktop + the motion strip), numbers sampled; kit ui look recorded (no look, no judge, no promote)
commands: lune run kit ui look <Screen> "<what you saw>"

judge.gate: two fresh judges for BUGS; the verifier's diff + edit per piece; the OWNER's verdict is the bar (judges underrate it by 30-45)
commands: lune run kit ui judge <Screen> [--record v.json]

promote.gate: saved in library/ui; uploaded (kit upload); promoted only on an owner verdict >= 7 with its data (render / trace / anchors / REFS)
commands: lune run kit ui vault check

dossier.gate: the MOVE DOSSIER complete (phases with timings, mechanics, cues, mistakes, the R6 translation, numeric checks); kit anim refuses without it
commands: lune run kit anim dossier new <move>

design.gate: a STRING of attacks starts as one design page (each attack's cut, height, body, frames, the pose it ends in; two attacks too alike named COUSINS) with the owner's yes to the drawn page; a new move of the set is refused before it. A move on its own skips this stage
commands: lune run kit anim design <Set> --approve "<his words>" --by owner --id <id>

blocking.gate: POSES FIRST, MOTION AFTER: the move's key poses HELD at its own timing, shown to the owner (sheet + real-time gif), his words kept with the pose, his yes to those poses; kit anim and kit anim candidates refuse a strike, sword or kick move made after the rule without it, and every build is held to them
commands: lune run kit anim block <Move> --note <pose> "<his words>"
lune run kit anim block <Move> --approve "<his words>" --by owner --id <id>

author.gate: made FROM SCRATCH (director -> gestures -> prior -> the spring engine, dense 60 fps curves) calibrated by the loved catalog's statistics — never splicing its poses

gates.gate: the motion gates (feet, pops, seam, Hit timing) + the proc gates (readable, statue, face, floaty, robot_arm, jitter, copy_floor) + the style band — filters, never a ranking

picks.gate: the move LOOKED AT large first - its key poses on the owner's rig from the player's camera, the side and above, beside the dossier's reference frames, every keys/ page opened (kit anim sheet; a named build ends with its LOOK: line); then ONE action, 4-12 candidates as real-time GIFs from the PLAYER's camera on the owner's rig with the fidelity line; the OWNER picks; breed from the picks
commands: lune run kit anim look <Name> --rig R6

studio.gate: the picked candidate plays in Studio on the owner's character, captured at its cue frames

verdict.gate: the owner's number recorded; promoted only on >= 7; the lesson written

refs.gate: >= 6 real stills measured (horizon line, value structure, haze, palette, landmark placement) into REFS.md; a world identity from the numbers
commands: lune run kit new world <Pascal> [--from BattlegroundsArena]

terrain.gate: land from real elevation (--dem) refined by rivers / erosion / the painter, the design anchors kept; the relief LOOKED at

materials.gate: the painter's roles as MaterialVariants from the scans, verified in Studio

meshes.gate: real vetted CC0 meshes for trees / rocks / cliffs; <= 10k parts; no z-fighting

dressing.gate: roads first; scatter / cover / breakables off the roads; set dressing by story

check.gate: kit world check: 0 errors (reachability, traps, spawn fairness, camera, knockback room), look lint clean

look.gate: every station at 1920 x 1080 on its own page, its reference still above ours at the same framing, every page opened (one difference + ONE edit per station); the viewer is art direction, not proof

studio.gate: the same stations captured in Roblox Studio's own light in the kit's scratch place (three panes a station: reference, Blender, Studio); walked in Studio through the MCP with 0 console errors; the OWNER walks it; the verdict recorded

refs.gate: up to three reference recordings per class chosen by the OWNER in booth rounds (Creator Store audio first, then CC0 / royalty-free)
commands: lune run kit sfx find "<words or a description>" [--describe]
lune run kit sfx listen <candidates> (the owner picks <= 3 per class: assets/sounds/references.json)

identity.gate: the game's sonic identity measured from the references; the set gate enforces it
commands: lune run kit sfx identity --from refs

design.gate: layers with ROLES, real sample layers, a SET with one DNA + weights + one loudness per class

match.gate: matched to its reference: one difference + ONE edit per role, never a score

sheet.gate: the sound sheet LOOKED at beside the reference (waveform, spectrogram, loudness, brightness over time)

booth.gate: the OWNER listens (scores 1-10, picks, words); the taste profile predicts only after the owner

av.gate: the sound on the SampleDojo's capture at the Hit frame; the A/V offset gate

runtime.gate: events in _events.json; Sfx.play / broadcast proven by a Studio playtest

upload.gate: uploaded, moderation checked, grants to the universe

brief.gate: the game folder exists (games/<Name>) and GAME.md's questions are answered with the owner

world.gate: an arena from the world generators with spawns and objectives; kit world check 0 errors
commands: lune run kit new world <Pascal> --from BattlegroundsArena --game <Name>

systems.gate: Config + Rules (pure) + Service + Controller + spec per system; hostile cases; fuzz 0 crashes; mutate kill rate >= 80%

net.gate: every remote from a schema (rate-limited, Guard-checked); kit audit green; the red-team playtest passes

moves.gate: moves as data with frames from the anim's measured phases; the move sheet looked at

playtests.gate: playtests driven in Studio; any console error fails; result files with the console log; the FEEL line

accept.gate: kit verify green; anything the owner rated >= 7 accepted as a floor that may not regress

audit.gate: every remote handler's arguments validated and rate-limited; no backdoor patterns

selftest.gate: every content gate catches its bad fixture

playtest.gate: in-engine scenarios through the Studio MCP; any console error fails

record.gate: the result recorded; a bug found becomes a spec + a mutation case

arrive.gate: your lane loaded (kit start <dept>: its boot sheet, stage, tasks, handoff, page) and the board read

work.gate: one discipline at a time; progress logged on the task

prove.gate: kit verify + kit selftest green; the evidence LOOKED at; the owner's verdict recorded

leave.gate: the handoff written, lessons recorded, proven work promoted (owner verdict >= 7), board/ committed
